unit.why: A list of R. Levi Yitzhak of Berditchev's habitual devotional practices: staying awake on Sukkot nights, kissing ritual objects, fervent blessings, raising idle speech. It is backed by a quoted testimony from the Kozhnitzer Maggid about his habit of chatting in tallit and tefillin. No single event happens to anyone, so there is no narrative.
unit.boundary_note: The next division (כא) opens a distinct anecdote (visit to R. Shmelke of Nikolsburg) on the same theme.
